title: Unit Event — A Sad Farewell at the Curtain Call — Episode7 Our Final Ambassadorial Show

meta.Event: A Sad Farewell at the Curtain Call
meta.Event Outline: The next ambassadorial performance is going to be the last one?! Wonderlands×Showtime is staggered to hear the news, but is followed by an offer to do a joint performance with a highly regarded theme park that puts on the best shows in Japan. As chaotic practices ensue, Rui is approached by a certain person...

rows.Line: The next day
Museum of Emerging Technologies - Main Gate Plaza

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Please bring that large prop over here. Yes, next to this pole will do just fine.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hey, Rui!
Is this spot about where we should be entering?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Mind showing me?
Maybe ten centimeters closer towards stage left...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Got it!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: By the way, Tsukasa, did you sleep well last night...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes! I stayed up to practice as much as I could, but managed to get in just enough sleep!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: All that's left is to do my best during the show.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Right.
I'll be looking forward to seeing a great performance from you.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: How are you doing, Asahi...?

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
Oh, the mats are all set!
They should be able to stay in place regardless of what's thrown at them!

rows.Speaker: Passerby A
rows.Line: Hey, what are they doing over there?

rows.Speaker: Passerby B
rows.Line:
Oh, let's see what the poster says.
PXL and ArcLand are doing a show together...?!

rows.Speaker: Passerby A
rows.Line:
Whoa, really?!
And Asahi Genbu's gonna be in it! Wanna check it out?

rows.Speaker: Passerby B
rows.Line:
Wait, Asahi's gonna be in it?
Yeah, definitely!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Rui still seems kinda unhappy...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, but he seems a little better compared to yesterday...

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member B
rows.Line:
Hm? Nene, Emu, what's wrong?
Are you feeling nervous?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Urgh!
N-No, we feel fine! Better than fine!

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member B
rows.Line: Really? Then, I guess there's nothing to worry about... Please let us know if something is wrong. We'll do our best to help.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
O-Okay.
We really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (He said he was fine when we made our way over here this morning...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But maybe the four of us should set aside some time after the show to talk...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Alright, it's nearly showtime.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We'll be doing three performances over two days for this. I know this still feels a bit strange since it's the first show we're doing together.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: However, I strongly believe we'll be able to really deliver.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So, let's all do our best.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa & Asahi
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Alright...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Let's give them the best show they've ever seen.

rows.Speaker: Major
rows.Line:
“The laboratory is ours!
However, we don't appear to be alone...”

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Wait, they're on top of the lamps! When did they get up there?!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Cool!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Excellent. The audience is captivated, just as we planned.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (The next moment's also one of the most important parts of the show since it's going to give them a nice jolt of excitement.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (That aspect of the show is second nature to our guests, while...)

rows.Speaker: Sergeant Willis
rows.Line:
“Major! There's only one android!
Our intel said that there'd be two...”

rows.Speaker: Major
rows.Line: “It must've been taken by those rats...! We'll pursue after them! Sergeant Willis, you are to secure the android that you've already found!”

rows.Speaker: Sergeant Willis
rows.Line: “Copy!”

rows.Speaker: Bartlett
rows.Line: “What happened? Where is the Professor? Please, explain to me what is going on...”

rows.Speaker: Sergeant Willis
rows.Line:
“Explain...?
Well...”

rows.Speaker: Sergeant Willis
rows.Line:
“You belong to us now.
So, you'll be taking orders from us.”

rows.Speaker: Bartlett
rows.Line: “But only the Professor can change who has administrator privileges over my systems. Where is he? Is he safe?”

rows.Speaker: Sergeant Willis
rows.Line:
“He isn't here anymore...
Sorry, but we'll just have to change those by brute force.”

rows.Speaker: Sergeant Willis
rows.Line: “Hmm... Apologizing to an android feels a bit strange.”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Tsukasa and Nene have improved their acting quite a bit. They certainly seem to have absorbed as much as they could from ArcLand's cast members.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I couldn't be more blessed to have them...

rows.Speaker: Alfred
rows.Line:
“Wh-Where am I?
I require positioning data for this area.”

rows.Speaker: Emma
rows.Line: “Here? It's the farm my grandpa started out here on the frontier, Mr. Robot! We found you collapsed on the ground!”

rows.Speaker: Alfred
rows.Line:
“I am not a robot. I am an android.
My name is Alfred Hawking.”

rows.Speaker: Sergeant Willis
rows.Line: “Have you downloaded the map for where the next battle is going to take place?”

rows.Speaker: Bartlett
rows.Line: “Yes. I have also found the evacuation routes that the civilians will likely be using.”

rows.Speaker: Sergeant Willis
rows.Line: “Were you ordered to do that...?”

rows.Speaker: Bartlett
rows.Line: “Yes. I was told that it would be absolutely necessary for this battle. Do you have any issues with that...?”

rows.Speaker: Sergeant Willis
rows.Line: “Not really...”

rows.Speaker: Emma
rows.Line:
“Al, help!
What do I do?! One of the calves ran away!”

rows.Speaker: Alfred
rows.Line:
“What?! No!
We must go after it at once!”

rows.Speaker: Emma
rows.Line:
“Thanks, Al!
Wait, watch out for the manure pit...”

rows.Speaker: Alfred
rows.Line: “Wah!”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (The two androids who ended up being raised in two completely different environments...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (However, as the front lines near the peaceful farmland, Alfred is forced to take up arms for the very first time in order to protect its residents.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (And our two androids are reunited on the battlefield...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Now, here comes the show's climax.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Break a leg, everyone...)

rows.Speaker: Bartlett
rows.Line: “My systems have been augmented specifically for the battlefield. How are you able to stand your ground against me?”

rows.Speaker: Alfred
rows.Line:
“I... I do not know...
But I...”

rows.Speaker: Alfred
rows.Line:
“I want to protect these people.
That may be the reason why I am able to summon more strength than I normally can.”

rows.Speaker: Bartlett
rows.Line: “I do not understand.”

rows.Speaker: Alfred
rows.Line: “Please, just try!!”

rows.Speaker: Bartlett
rows.Line:
“No, I will not.
I cannot fathom your motives.”

rows.Speaker: Alfred
rows.Line: “I do not wish to kill you, Bartlett!!”

rows.Speaker: Alfred
rows.Line: “The only thing that separates us is the environments in which we were raised!”

rows.Speaker: Alfred
rows.Line: “We would not be doing this right now if you were not taught to kill!”

rows.Speaker: Bartlett
rows.Line: “But that is what I was taught. That is reality. So, I must defeat you.”

rows.Speaker: Alfred
rows.Line: “Bartlett!”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Towards the end of the battle, Alfred somehow manages to damage Bartlett's power core...)

rows.Speaker: Alfred
rows.Line: “Ba-Ba-Bartlett...!!”

rows.Speaker: Bartlett
rows.Line:
“Why are you crying...?
You are the victor.”

rows.Speaker: Alfred
rows.Line:
“How can you call this victory?!
There are no winners here...!!”

rows.Speaker: Bartlett
rows.Line: “I still do not understand...”

rows.Speaker: Bartlett
rows.Line:
“However...
It may have been nice to see...”

rows.Speaker: Alfred
rows.Line: “What?”

rows.Speaker: Bartlett
rows.Line:
“To see where you grew up...
I wonder how I would have...”

rows.Speaker: Alfred
rows.Line: “Bartlett!!”

rows.Speaker: Emma
rows.Line: “Al! They just said on the news how our country beat that other country! That means you don't have to fight anymore...”

rows.Speaker: Emma
rows.Line: “Oh no...!”

rows.Speaker: Sergeant Willis
rows.Line:
“Bartlett!!
No... Why did it have to be like this...?”

rows.Speaker: Alfred
rows.Line: “Why did I have to be the one to kill you...?”

rows.Speaker: Sergeant Willis
rows.Line:
“No, he's still alive...!
There should be a backup battery within his power core! As long that you didn't damage that...”

rows.Speaker: Sergeant Willis
rows.Line:
“I-It looks like it's gonna short...!
Do you have any tools I can borrow?!”

rows.Speaker: Emma
rows.Line:
“Yeah, we have some in the barn!
I'll go get them now!”

rows.Speaker: Alfred
rows.Line: “I have no idea who you are, but please save him...! Please... I beg you...!!”

rows.Speaker: Sergeant Willis
rows.Line:
“Hang on...
Are you the other android? Did you and Bartlett come from the same laboratory?”

rows.Speaker: Alfred
rows.Line:
“Y-Yes, that is correct...
I was found on this farm and have been working here for ten years now.”

rows.Speaker: Sergeant Willis
rows.Line: “I see...”

rows.Speaker: Sergeant Willis
rows.Line: “If Bart hadn't ended up with us, he might've been given a chance to lead a better life... Like you...”

rows.Speaker: Alfred
rows.Line: “What...?”

rows.Speaker: Emma
rows.Line:
“I found the tools!
I really hope they help.”

rows.Speaker: Sergeant Willis
rows.Line:
“I'll try my best...!
But this is my first time doing this, so I can't guarantee anything...”

rows.Speaker: Sergeant Willis
rows.Line:
“There...!
We should be able to reboot him now...!”

rows.Speaker: Sergeant Willis
rows.Line: “But I need to ask you something before I do...”

rows.Speaker: Sergeant Willis
rows.Line: “If we allow him to reboot normally, he'll probably go straight back to being a weapon of war.”

rows.Speaker: Sergeant Willis
rows.Line: “However, if we perform a full reset, we'd be able to erase all of his memories and give him another chance.”

rows.Speaker: Sergeant Willis
rows.Line: “I want to erase all the horrible things we taught him. But as the one who was created alongside him, I need to know how you'd feel about that...”

rows.Speaker: Alfred
rows.Line: “No, please do not reset him...”

rows.Speaker: Alfred
rows.Line: “Turning him into a blank slate may be easier... But only he knows the value of everything that he experienced these past ten years.”

rows.Speaker: Alfred
rows.Line: “So, please leave his memories intact.”

rows.Speaker: Alfred
rows.Line: “Instead, would you mind installing this for me...?”

rows.Speaker: Sergeant Willis
rows.Line: “Are these memories...?”

rows.Speaker: Alfred
rows.Line: “They are mine. From these past ten years.”

rows.Speaker: Alfred
rows.Line:
“I want Bartlett to see them.
I want him to see how beautiful this world is, and why I am able to feel.”

rows.Speaker: Sergeant Willis
rows.Line:
“Okay...
I'll install this before rebooting him.”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (This is your moment, Tsukasa...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Hold back as much as you can, and let just a little bit eke out...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Show us the never-before-seen moment where an android develops real, human emotions!)

rows.Speaker: Bartlett
rows.Line:
“Where am I...?
I am seeing readings that my power core was destroyed...”

rows.Speaker: Alfred
rows.Line: “Bartlett...!”

rows.Speaker: Bartlett
rows.Line:
“Alfred...
Did you wake me...?”

rows.Speaker: Sergeant Willis
rows.Line: “Yes, he did.”

rows.Speaker: Bartlett
rows.Line: “I see...”

rows.Speaker: Bartlett
rows.Line:
“Alfred...
It appears that there is a mission that I must accomplish right now.”

rows.Speaker: Alfred
rows.Line: “What?”

rows.Speaker: Bartlett
rows.Line: “Will you show me what I saw in these memories?”

rows.Speaker: Bartlett
rows.Line: “This beauty you saw over these past ten years?”

rows.Speaker: Bartlett
rows.Line: “Then... I may begin to understand who you are...”

rows.Speaker: Alfred
rows.Line:
“Yes...
Yes, of course.”

rows.Speaker: Alfred
rows.Line: “And... We can keep creating new memories together... Bart...”

rows.Speaker: Bartlett
rows.Line: “I would like that very much... Al...”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I really do love these moments...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (When everybody takes my direction on board and their hard work blooms into a wonderful spectacle. Also...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (When I get to see that my direction has moved everyone's dreams along and made them smile...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I can't get enough of those moments...)
The next day

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thank you all very much for coming to see us!!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Thank you very much!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Wow, we did it...!
We managed to make it through both days without incident!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah!
And the audience looked super happy!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
They really did.
Also, in comparison to our first performance, I think around double the people came to watch us.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: If anything, Tsukasa, we have you to thank for showing such tremendous growth!

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: The final scene was as incredible as it was because you put so much effort into it.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: And it was so cool to watch! I guess that's Miles for you!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
...!
Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: However, it's sad to think how this may be the last conversation we have together.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (The last one...?)

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
I agree...
But this month was so much fun. So, thank you all very much.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Thank you as well!
It was nice working with you!

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Anyway, let's start cleaning everything up.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Asahi...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: After we finish cleaning up, can we talk?

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
...!
Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay, until then...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Rui...?
By the Fountain

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I apologize in advance for doing this right after our show. I'm sure you're very tired, Asahi...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
No, I'm okay.
I have triple the stamina of a normal person!

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Anyway...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Have you reached a decision?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes...

source: https://storage.sekai.best/sekai-en-assets/event_story/…（SEKAI master database + SEKAI Viewer 资源，官方文本）
